title: Event Envelope
description: Common envelope shared by all events in LinkFlow. The payload field is event-specific and validated by its own schema.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier. Used for idempotency. UUID v7 preferred, v4 acceptable.

event_type.description: Stable business event name in dotted lowercase form, e.g. 'device.telemetry.received'. Must match the producer's intent and remain stable across schema versions.

event_version.description: Schema version of the payload. Incremented on every change to the payload schema. The subject's major version (lf.v1.*) only changes on breaking changes.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp marking when the business fact occurred. Producers should set this to the actual event time, not the publish time.

producer.description: Identifier of the service that produced the event, e.g. 'ingest-gateway', 'rule-engine'. Lowercase, kebab-case.

tenant_id.description: Tenant boundary identifier. Use 'default' if multi-tenancy is not yet enabled, but the field is required from day one.

trace_id.description: W3C Trace Context trace ID (32 hex characters). Optional but recommended for observability. Producers should propagate the active trace context.

correlation_id.description: Workflow or external request identifier shared by related events. Used to query all events caused by the same user action, device session, rule run, or command workflow.

causation_id.description: Event ID of the event that directly caused this event. Used to reconstruct event chains across services.

payload.description: Event-specific business data. Validated by the payload schema corresponding to event_type and event_version.
